sources.list:
• Borders: Cliopatria, Seshat Global History Databank, CC BY 4.0. Simplified for display.
  • Key figures and links between realms: Wikidata, CC0.
  • Globe imagery: Natural Earth II, public domain, as packaged with CesiumJS (Apache 2.0).
  • Events: the Mongol ones written for this prototype from standard references, the others from Wikidata (CC0) with the opening paragraph of their Wikipedia article (CC BY-SA); pictures from the events’ Wikipedia articles, shown only when the file is on Wikimedia Commons, with its author and licence.
  • Map coastlines: Natural Earth 1:50m land, public domain, via world-atlas (ISC). Projections by d3-geo (ISC).
